subject: general
question: Which of the following strait connects the Atlantic Ocean with the Pacific Ocean?
solution:
The correct answer is __**the Strait of Magellan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Magellan Strait,** also known as the Magellan Channel, is a passable maritime channel in southern Chile that connects mainland South America to Tierra del Fuego.
 
• The strait is the most important natural connection between the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.
 
• It was discovered and traversed by Europeans for the first time in 1520 by a Spanish expedition led by Portuguese explorer** Ferdinand Magellan**, after whom it is called.
 
• The strait had previously been navigated by indigenous peoples in canoes, including the Kawésqar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Dardanelle, also known as the Strait of Gallipoli** from the Gallipoli peninsula or the Hellespont from Classical Antiquity, is a thin, natural strait in northwestern Turkey that separates Asian Turkey from European Turkey and constitutes part of the continental barrier between Asia and Europe.
 
• **The Strait of Malacca **is a 580-mile-long strait that connects the Malay Peninsula to the Indonesian island of Sumatra.
 
• **The Palk Strait** connects the Indian state of Tamil Nadu with the Jaffna District in Sri Lanka's Northern Province.
